units.source_text: 这是县界的山，山下备有三辆扫雪车，供下雪天使用。

en.t: This was a mountain on the prefectural border, and three snowplows were kept at its foot for use on snowy days.

units.source_text: 隧道南北，架设了电力控制的雪崩报警线。

en.t: To the north and south of the tunnel, electrically controlled avalanche alarm lines had been installed.

units.source_text: 部署了五千名扫雪工和二千名消防队的青年队员。

en.t: Five thousand snow-clearing workers and two thousand young members of the fire brigade had been deployed.
